text:
sam: Found a tiny folded note in the ficus pot by the kitchen sink: 'For tiny victories' :seedling:
alex: Is this the start of an office scavenger hunt??
katie: tiny victories > big spreadsheets. I support this mission.
jordan: 10/10 would adopt the ficus as team mascot :leafy_heart:
maria: @sam pls check for glitter. last time there was glitter, we had a covert party.
ben: cleaned the ficus as part of my janitor rounds — no glitter, but there's a thumbtack near the base :thinking_face:
alex: thumbtack energy. suspiciously like last week's whiteboard pin heist.
katie: suggestion: label ficus 'Honorary Intern' and give it a tiny badge.
sam: adding a sticky with a hand-drawn badge now. will accept submissions for titles and one-liners.
jordan: 'Chief Quiet Listener' — I nominate
maria: 'Head of Micro-Morale' — first one-liner: coffee > meetings :coffee:
ben: cleaning-bot: scheduled watering set to 'complimentary optimism' every Tue/Thu. :robot_face:
sam: ok this escalated into tiny office bureaucracy and I love it. sticky art contest tomorrow? :tada:
alex: I'll bring mini clothespins for badges. and possibly a confetti-free glitter alternative.
katie: vote: sticky art contest time? :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:
alex: :thumbsup:
jordan: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
ben: :thumbsup:
cleaning-bot: maintenance reminder — please do not over-water plants during sticky art festivities. :sweat_smile:
